children: Hyperliquid ranked third in revenue over the past 24 hours, recording $3.91 million. According to Odaily, revenue over the past seven days reached $18.37 million, up 20.37%. Perpetual futures trading volume totaled $71.567 billion, an increase of 14.36% from the previous seven-day period. Perpetual futures contributed $17.76 million, about 97% of total revenue.

title: Hyperliquid Ranks Third With $3.91 Million in Revenue in the Past 24 Hours
